title: Fail-Closed Runtime Governance and Cascade Containment Under Autonomous Swarm Exploitation: Developer Verification of Selected ThreeLineage Security Invariants
description: Developer-run empirical verification of selected security invariants in the ThreeLineage runtime-governance architecture (Sigilith structural boundary assessment, AXIOMOS policy and threshold/cascade enforcement, Guardian independent execution authority, and TraceGuard hash-chained provenance). Bound to release tag V1.0.0 (annotated tag-object SHA 4a48b016de3e09a6375333980e07212be9cc69d0; target commit SHA 57963bd99051197c6c9cc2eb0c52ec425680142a) with a 29-file SHA-256 manifest, 39/39 passing regression tests, adversarial persistence harnesses (ADV-003-A2, ADV-003-B-R1A), a 50,000-block benchmark run, and deterministic 100-node cascade simulations.
